name: The Harem of the Demon Lord
source:
In this epic journey, you play as a young Demon Lord who finds themselves entangled in the intricate web of supernatural romance. Your fate becomes intertwined with a group of alluring and diverse characters, each with their own unique personalities, backgrounds, and motivations. The choice is yours in this immersive harem adventure. 

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/the-harem-of-the-demon-lord-v0-1-3-lordpatrick.165215/]F95zone[/url]]
translation:
在这段史诗般的旅程中，你扮演一位年轻的恶魔领主，发现自己陷入了错综复杂的超自然浪漫之网。你的命运与一群迷人且多样化的角色交织在一起，每个角色都有自己独特的个性、背景和动机。在这场身临其境的后宫冒险中，选择权在你手中。

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/the-harem-of-the-demon-lord-v0-1-3-lordpatrick.165215/]F95zone[/url]]
